articles.headline: World Cup Daily LIVE: England score twice against Panama, Croatia lead Ghana
articles.description: It's the final day of World Cup action from the group stages, as Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo and Argentina's Lionel Messi (maybe) could play on the same day.

articles.headline: Harry Kane becomes England's leading goalscorer at World Cups after scoring vs. Panama
articles.description: Harry Kane has become England's all-time leading scorer at the World Cup after scoring in the Three Lions' final group stage game vs. Panama.

articles.headline: Spain's Nico Williams on injury: One of worst days of my life
articles.description: Spain winger Nico Williams said he had suffered "one of the worst days of my life" after an injury against Uruguay on Friday jeopardized his future participation in the World Cup.

articles.headline: Croatia v Ghana LIVE - Follow along as the Black Stars look to recover
articles.description: Ghana go into their final group game against Croatia on Saturday knowing that results elsewhere have already secured them their place in the World Cup knockout stages for the first time since 2010.

articles.headline: Netherlands forward Cody Gakpo shares loss of unborn son
articles.description: Netherlands forward Cody Gakpo's partner announced Saturday their unborn son had died during pregnancy.

articles.headline: 2026 World Cup: How teams can advance to the knockout rounds
articles.description: Who can secure qualification before the group stage ends, and whose World Cup dreams could be shattered? Here's what you need to know.
